# ASTROHEALTH
### 04 | Mission Connection Monitor
Manual, read-only status snapshot. Backend owns Earth dispatch, retry and ACK.
**Status:** API tested locally; n8n integration pending.

## 01. Read mission status
Authenticated GET to current backend.
Manual execution; no webhook or scheduling.

## 02. Interpret snapshot
CONNECTED / DISCONNECTED; local monitoring string.
IDLE / PENDING / PAUSED / CHECK_FAILED / INVALID_STATUS_RESPONSE.
No claim of delivery; last_sync_at may be null.
Backend owns ingestion, dispatch and ACK.
Verify disconnect and pending cases with backend.
